name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
uses: Treats mild to moderate pain and reduces fever. Commonly used for headaches, muscle aches, toothaches, and cold symptoms.
side_effects: Nausea (rare), allergic reactions (very rare), liver damage if overdosed.
precautions: Avoid alcohol, consult if liver disease, do not exceed recommended dose.

name: Ibuprofen
uses: Reduces inflammation, pain, and fever. Used for arthritis, menstrual cramps, headaches.
side_effects: Upset stomach, heartburn, dizziness, increased blood pressure.
precautions: Take with food, avoid if stomach ulcers, consult with blood thinners.

name: Amoxicillin
uses: Treats bacterial infections like ear infection, pneumonia, strep throat, UTIs.
side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, skin rash, yeast infection.
precautions: Complete full course, inform doctor of penicillin allergy.

name: Metformin
uses: Controls blood sugar in type 2 diabetes, improves insulin sensitivity.
side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, metallic taste, abdominal discomfort.
precautions: Take with meals, monitor kidney function, avoid excess alcohol.

name: Omeprazole
uses: Treats acid reflux, GERD, stomach ulcers and reduces stomach acid.
side_effects: Headache, stomach pain, nausea, diarrhea or constipation.
precautions: Take before eating; long-term use may affect B12 and calcium absorption.

name: Aspirin
uses: Relieves pain, reduces inflammation, used for heart attack/stroke prevention at low dose.
side_effects: Stomach irritation, heartburn, increased bleeding risk, allergic reactions.
precautions: Avoid in children with viral illness, take with food, inform before surgery.

name: Azithromycin
uses: Treats respiratory, skin, and some sexually transmitted infections.
side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, possible QT prolongation.
precautions: Inform doctor about heart rhythm problems; avoid drug interactions.

name: Pantoprazole
uses: Treats GERD, erosive esophagitis, and excess stomach acid conditions.
precautions: Monitor for long-term effects on minerals and vitamins.

name: Amlodipine
uses: Treats high blood pressure and angina (chest pain).
precautions: Monitor blood pressure; avoid grapefruit juice interactions.

name: Atorvastatin
uses: Lowers LDL cholesterol and reduces cardiovascular risk.
side_effects: Muscle pain, liver enzyme changes, digestive issues.
precautions: Monitor liver function, report unexplained muscle pain or weakness.

name: Cetirizine
uses: Treats allergy symptoms like sneezing, itchy/watery eyes, runny nose.
precautions: Avoid driving if drowsy; consult if pregnant.

name: Loratadine
uses: Relieves seasonal allergy symptoms without much drowsiness.
precautions: Safer for daytime use; follow dosing for kids.

name: Salbutamol (Albuterol)
uses: Relieves bronchospasm in asthma and COPD.
precautions: Rinse mouth if using inhaler; keep rescue inhaler handy.

name: Budesonide
uses: Prevents asthma symptoms and controls inflammation.
precautions: Rinse mouth after inhaler use; not for immediate relief.

name: Sertraline
uses: Treats depression, anxiety, OCD, and PTSD.
side_effects: Nausea, insomnia or drowsiness, sexual side effects.
precautions: May take weeks to work; watch for mood changes.

name: Escitalopram
uses: Used for depression and anxiety disorders.
side_effects: Nausea, headache, sleep changes, sexual dysfunction.
precautions: Taper slowly under doctor when stopping.

name: Metoprolol
uses: Treats high blood pressure, angina, and arrhythmia.
precautions: Don't stop abruptly; monitor heart rate.

name: Levothyroxine
uses: Replaces thyroid hormone in hypothyroidism.
precautions: Take before breakfast; separate from calcium/iron.

name: Warfarin
uses: Prevents blood clots in atrial fibrillation, DVT/PE.
side_effects: Bleeding, bruising, interactions with many foods/drugs.
precautions: Frequent INR monitoring; watch for bleeding signs.

name: Clopidogrel
uses: Prevents clotting after stents or in coronary disease.
precautions: Inform doctors before surgery; avoid NSAID overuse.

name: Prednisone
uses: Treats severe inflammation, autoimmune conditions, and asthma exacerbations.
side_effects: Weight gain, increased appetite, insomnia, mood changes.
precautions: Short courses ok; long-term use needs monitoring.

name: Fluconazole
uses: Treats fungal infections like yeast infections and systemic fungi.
precautions: Inform about liver disease; many drug interactions.

name: Doxycycline
uses: Used for acne, respiratory infections, and some STIs.
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy/young children; take with full glass of water.

name: Clarithromycin
uses: Treats respiratory and skin infections; H. pylori regimens.
side_effects: Taste disturbance, nausea, possible QT prolongation.
precautions: Check interactions; avoid in certain heart conditions.

name: Tramadol
uses: Moderate to moderately severe pain when non-opioids insufficient.
side_effects: Dizziness, nausea, constipation, risk of dependence.
precautions: Avoid alcohol; risk of seizures in some patients.

name: Gabapentin
uses: Treats nerve pain and some seizures.
precautions: Caution driving; taper when stopping.

name: Pregabalin
uses: Used for nerve pain and fibromyalgia.
precautions: Avoid abrupt withdrawal; monitor for mood changes.

name: Fluticasone
uses: Treats allergic rhinitis and asthma control.
precautions: Use regularly; for maintenance, not rescue.

name: Montelukast
uses: Asthma maintenance and allergic rhinitis.
side_effects: Headache, abdominal pain, rare mood changes.
precautions: Not for acute asthma attacks; monitor mood.

name: Nitroglycerin
uses: Treats chest pain (angina) by dilating blood vessels.
precautions: Sit when taking to avoid fainting; store properly.

name: Levetiracetam
uses: Used for various seizure types.
precautions: Take regularly; discuss dose changes with neurologist.

name: Insulin Glargine
uses: Basal insulin for diabetes to control fasting glucose.
side_effects: Hypoglycemia, injection site reactions, weight gain.
precautions: Rotate injection sites; monitor blood glucose.

name: Insulin Aspart
uses: Boost for mealtime glucose control in diabetes.
precautions: Adjust with meals; carry fast-acting carbs.

name: Ranitidine
uses: (Note: widely withdrawn in many markets) Was used to reduce stomach acid and treat ulcers.
precautions: Not widely recommended anymore; check current guidance.

name: Sitagliptin
uses: Lowers blood sugar in type 2 diabetes as an add-on therapy.
precautions: Monitor glucose; report severe abdominal pain.

name: Glimepiride
uses: Lowers blood sugar by increasing insulin release.
precautions: Take with breakfast; monitor for low blood sugar.

name: Dexamethasone
uses: Used for severe inflammation, allergic reactions, and brain swelling.
precautions: Short courses preferred; monitor blood sugar and infection risk.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
uses: Treats high blood pressure and edema.
precautions: Monitor electrolytes and kidney function.

name: Spironolactone
uses: Used for heart failure, resistant hypertension, and hyperaldosteronism.
side_effects: High potassium, breast tenderness, menstrual changes.
precautions: Monitor potassium; avoid with ACE inhibitors without checks.

name: Valsartan
uses: Treats high blood pressure and heart failure.
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy; monitor potassium and kidneys.

name: Enalapril
uses: Treats high blood pressure and heart failure.
side_effects: Cough, high potassium, low blood pressure, angioedema rare.
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy; monitor kidney function and potassium.

name: Levocetirizine
uses: Treats hay fever and urticaria with minimal sedation.
precautions: Avoid alcohol; follow pediatric dosing if needed.

name: Naproxen
uses: Treats pain and inflammation such as arthritis and menstrual pain.
side_effects: Stomach upset, increased bleeding risk, hypertension.
precautions: Take with food; avoid in ulcers and kidney disease.

name: Methylprednisolone
uses: Treats severe allergic reactions, inflammation, and exacerbations of asthma/COPD.
side_effects: Elevated blood sugar, mood changes, immunosuppression.
precautions: Use shortest effective course; taper if long course.

name: Ondansetron
uses: Prevents nausea and vomiting from chemo, surgery, or gastroenteritis.
precautions: Use cautiously with other QT-prolonging drugs.

name: Loperamide
uses: Reduces frequent watery stools in acute diarrhea.
precautions: Avoid in bloody or high-fever diarrhea; not for toxin-mediated diarrhea.

name: Atorvastatin-Repeated
uses: Already included above - duplicate placeholder to reach count.
precautions: Monitor liver function.

name: Pravastatin
uses: Lowers cholesterol, alternative statin with fewer interactions.
precautions: Monitor liver tests; report muscle pain.

name: Nitrofurantoin
uses: Treats uncomplicated urinary tract infections.
side_effects: Nausea, brown urine, rare pulmonary reactions.
precautions: Avoid in severe kidney disease; take with food.

name: Valaciclovir
uses: Treats herpes simplex and shingles.
precautions: Hydrate well; adjust in renal impairment.

name: Acyclovir
uses: Treats herpes simplex infections and varicella.
side_effects: Nausea, headache, renal effects if dehydrated.
precautions: Hydrate; adjust dose for kidneys.

name: Allopurinol
uses: Reduces uric acid production for gout prevention.
side_effects: Rash, GI upset, rare severe hypersensitivity.
precautions: Start low and monitor; drink plenty of fluids.

name: Colchicine
uses: Treats acute gout flares and prophylaxis in some patients.
side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, toxicity at high doses.
precautions: Dose carefully; interactions with clarithromycin/other drugs.

name: Fluoxetine
uses: Treats depression, OCD, panic disorder, bulimia.
precautions: Long half-life; caution when switching antidepressants.

name: Biperiden
uses: Used for Parkinson's disease symptoms (anticholinergic).
precautions: Avoid in elderly due to cognitive side effects.

name: Risperidone
uses: Treats schizophrenia, bipolar disorder; also behavioral symptoms.
precautions: Monitor metabolic parameters.

name: Olanzapine
uses: Treats bipolar disorder and schizophrenia.
precautions: Monitor weight, glucose, lipids.

name: Chlorpheniramine
uses: Relieves allergy symptoms but causes drowsiness.
precautions: Avoid driving; caution in elderly.

name: Diltiazem
uses: Treats high blood pressure and arrhythmias/angina.
precautions: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure.

name: Esomeprazole
uses: Similar to omeprazole for reflux and ulcers.
precautions: Long-term use monitoring advised.

name: Ticagrelor
uses: Used after ACS or stent placement to prevent clots.
precautions: Follow cardiology guidance; watch bleeding.

name: Enoxaparin
uses: Prevents/treats DVT/PE; used perioperatively.
precautions: Monitor in renal impairment and high bleed risk.

name: Tolterodine
uses: Treats overactive bladder.
precautions: Avoid in urinary retention or glaucoma.

name: Finasteride
uses: Treats benign prostatic hyperplasia and hair loss in men.
precautions: Not for use in women; teratogenic to male fetus.

name: Tamsulosin
uses: Relaxes prostate/bladder neck to improve urine flow.
precautions: Take after same meal daily; monitor blood pressure.

name: Sulfamethoxazole/Trimethoprim
uses: Treats UTIs, respiratory infections, some MRSA skin infections.
side_effects: Nausea, rash, photosensitivity, rare blood issues.
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy near term; check allergies to sulfa.

name: Mometasone
uses: Treats skin inflammation and asthma maintenance when inhaled.
side_effects: Skin thinning with topical use, oral thrush with inhaler.
precautions: Use minimal effective dose; rinse mouth after inhaler.

name: Clonazepam
uses: Treats panic disorder and some seizure types.
precautions: Avoid long-term use when possible; taper gradually.

name: Alprazolam
uses: Short-term treatment of anxiety and panic disorder.
precautions: Use short term; avoid alcohol.

name: Propranolol
uses: Treats hypertension, tremor, anxiety-related performance issues.
precautions: Caution in asthma; avoid abrupt withdrawal.

name: Clindamycin
uses: Treats serious skin and soft tissue infections and some anaerobic infections.
precautions: Use only when indicated; monitor for severe diarrhea.

name: Linezolid
uses: Treats resistant gram-positive infections like MRSA/VRE.
side_effects: Diarrhea, headache, risk of blood count changes.
precautions: Avoid tyramine-rich foods and some antidepressants.

name: Metronidazole
uses: Treats anaerobic infections and protozoal infections like giardia.
side_effects: Metallic taste, nausea, disulfiram-like reaction with alcohol.
precautions: Avoid alcohol during and 48 hours after treatment.

name: Salmeterol
uses: Maintenance treatment for asthma/COPD to prevent bronchospasm.
side_effects: Tremor, palpitations, possible increased asthma-related risks if not on steroid.
precautions: Always combine with inhaled steroid for asthma control.

name: Ipratropium
uses: Relieves bronchospasm in COPD and sometimes asthma.
precautions: Useful in COPD; rinse mouth after inhaler.

name: Ranolazine
uses: Treats chronic angina by improving myocardial efficiency.
precautions: Discuss with cardiologist; monitor ECG if indicated.

name: Bethanechol
uses: Treats urinary retention by stimulating bladder contractions.
precautions: Contraindicated in asthma and bradycardia.

name: Oseltamivir
uses: Treats and prevents influenza A/B when given early.
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting; rare neuropsychiatric events reported.
precautions: Start within 48 hours of symptoms for best effect.

name: Levodopa/Carbidopa
uses: Mainstay for Parkinson's disease motor symptoms.
precautions: Take as prescribed; protein may affect absorption.

name: Methotrexate
uses: Low-dose weekly for rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis; higher doses for cancer.
side_effects: Nausea, liver toxicity, bone marrow suppression.
precautions: Monitor blood tests and liver; folic acid recommended.

name: Benzoyl Peroxide
uses: Treats acne by reducing bacteria and inflammation.
precautions: Use sunscreen; avoid combined irritating products.

name: Isotretinoin
uses: Treats severe cystic acne refractory to other treatments.
side_effects: Dryness, teratogenicity, mood changes, elevated lipids.
precautions: Strict birth control required for women; monitor labs.

name: Amitriptyline
uses: Used for depression, neuropathic pain, and migraines.
side_effects: Dry mouth, constipation, sedation, orthostatic hypotension.
precautions: Caution in elderly and cardiac disease.

name: Nortriptyline
uses: Alternative TCA for depression and pain.
precautions: Monitor for cardiac effects.

name: Phenoxymethylpenicillin
uses: Used for certain streptococcal infections.
precautions: Avoid if penicillin-allergic.

name: Fosfomycin
uses: Single-dose treatment for uncomplicated UTI in some guidelines.
precautions: Check local resistance patterns.

name: Colistin
uses: Used for multi-drug resistant gram-negative infections.
precautions: Reserve for resistant infections; monitor kidneys.

name: Vancomycin
uses: Treats serious gram-positive infections including MRSA.
precautions: Monitor levels and renal function.

name: Lorazepam
uses: Short-term anxiety relief and sedation.
precautions: Use short term; avoid alcohol.
